entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""That brings me to my next question..."
entries.dialogueText: "That brings me to my next question. What about the status of Sordland's minorities? I'm speaking particularly about the Bluds."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm proud to say that under my adm..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm proud to say that under my administration, the Bludish community has been given a voice."
entries.menuText: "I'm proud to say that under my administration, the Bludish community has been given a voice."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""I will work with the WPB to ensure..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will work with the WPB to ensure the Bludish people get the equal status they have been denied for so long."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The work I've done to further the..."
entries.dialogueText: "The work I've done to further the Bludish cause was just the beginning. We still have a long way to go."
entries.menuText: "The work I've done to further the Bludish cause was just the beginning. We still have a long way to go."

entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""Ah. Um, right. Onto the next quest..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah. Um, right. Onto the next question--"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The events of the past four years..."
entries.dialogueText: "The events of the past four years have proven that peaceful coexistence between Sords and Bluds is a mere pipe dream."
entries.menuText: "The events of the past four years have proven that peaceful coexistence between Sords and Bluds is a mere pipe dream."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes, we will all work together.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, we will all work together."
entries.menuText: "Yes, we will all work together."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'd like to yield the floor to Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd like to yield the floor to Mr. Leke."
entries.menuText: "I'd like to yield the floor to Mr. Leke."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I have shown nothing but kindness..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have shown nothing but kindness towards the Bluds, and they have reacted only with violence."
entries.menuText: "I have shown nothing but kindness towards the Bluds, and they have reacted only with violence."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I signaled to the moderator to move..."
entries.dialogueText: I signaled to the moderator to move on.
entries.menuText: Signal to the moderator to skip this question.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I didn't say anything."
entries.dialogueText: I didn't say anything.
entries.menuText: Say nothing.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I have no problem with the Bludish..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have no problem with the Bludish community as long as they make an effort to integrate into Sordish society. Like Mr. Leke here."
entries.menuText: "I have no problem with the Bludish community as long as they make an effort to integrate into Sordish society. Like Mr. Leke here."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thousands suffered under Soll. We..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thousands suffered under Soll. We cannot go back to that."
entries.menuText: "Thousands suffered under Soll. We cannot go back to that."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You, ma'am, are no Tarquin Soll.""
entries.dialogueText: "You, ma'am, are no Tarquin Soll."
entries.menuText: "You, ma'am, are no Tarquin Soll."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""He's in prison, Lileas. For a reas..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's in prison, Lileas. For a reason."
entries.menuText: "He's in prison, Lileas. For a reason."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""He's dead, Lileas. For a reason.""
entries.dialogueText: "He's dead, Lileas. For a reason."
entries.menuText: "He's dead, Lileas. For a reason."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mansoun smiled."
entries.dialogueText: Mansoun smiled.

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""I will work with the WPB to ensure..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will work with the WPB to ensure the Bludish people get the representation he has denied them."

entries.speaker: Manoly Suheil
entries.title: Manoly Suheil: ""I will work with the WPB to ensure..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will work with the WPB to ensure the Bludish people get the equal status they have been denied for so long."

entries.speaker: Manoly Suheil
entries.title: Manoly Suheil: ""I will work with the WPB to ensure..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will work with the WPB to ensure the Bludish people get the representation he has denied them."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""The BFF and the Bludish people are..."
entries.dialogueText: "The BFF and the Bludish people are not one and the same."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mansoun shook his head sadly."
entries.dialogueText: Mansoun shook his head sadly.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Good luck getting the Assembly to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good luck getting the Assembly to agree on that."
entries.menuText: "Good luck getting the Assembly to agree on that."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""It is true that President Rayne ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is true that President Rayne has only stoked the fires of xenophobia in Sordland."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""As you can tell, xenophobia is ali..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you can tell, xenophobia is alive and well in Sordland. Despite the president's best efforts."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""It isn't too late to go back to th..."
entries.dialogueText: "It isn't too late to go back to the way things were. Under the USP, the glorious republic envisioned by Tarquin Soll can still become a reality."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""We talk about safety when our coun..."
entries.dialogueText: "We talk about safety when our country is facing conditions of insurgency?!"

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""Safe? Safe?!""
entries.dialogueText: "Safe? Safe?!"

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Mr. President, I won't allow you t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, I won't allow you to bring me into this. Not after the way our last talk ended."

entries.speaker: Manoly Suheil
entries.title: Manoly Suheil: ""As you can tell, xenophobia is ali..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you can tell, xenophobia is alive and well in Sordland. Despite the president's best efforts."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Mr. President, I won't allow you t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, I won't allow you to bring me into this. Not after the way you've treated my compatriots."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""To speak more generally, haven't w..."
entries.dialogueText: "To speak more generally, haven't we all had enough of upheaval? Of promises of radical change? Of having to check newspaper headlines daily to be sure our country is still intact?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mansoun struggled to stay calm."
entries.dialogueText: Mansoun struggled to stay calm.

entries.speaker: Manoly Suheil
entries.title: Manoly Suheil: ""It is true that President Rayne ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is true that President Rayne has only stoked the fires of xenophobia in Sordland."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""How dare you say that, Mr. Preside..."
entries.dialogueText: "How dare you say that, Mr. President?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mansoun struggled to stay calm."
entries.dialogueText: Mansoun struggled to stay calm.

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""The absence of the WPB in this stu..."
entries.dialogueText: "The absence of the WPB in this studio speaks louder than your lies."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""President Rayne was only able to g..."
entries.dialogueText: "President Rayne was only able to grant the Bludish people a small modicum of justice by exercising his executive powers. This has not magically erased centuries of anti-Bludish sentiment."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Negotiating with terrorists. A dan..."
entries.dialogueText: "Negotiating with terrorists. A dangerous mistake."
entries.menuText: "Negotiating with terrorists. A dangerous mistake."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""President Rayne has proven himself..."
entries.dialogueText: "President Rayne has proven himself a more tolerant leader than his predecessors, but anti-Bludish sentiment remains deeply ingrained in our society."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Surely there's a compromise betwee..."
entries.dialogueText: "Surely there's a compromise between meeting the demands of violent militants and oppressing innocent civilians in a way that only incites further violence."

entries.speaker: Manoly Suheil
entries.title: Manoly Suheil: ""I'll spare you viewers another of..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll spare you viewers another of the NFP's racist tirades."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The moderator hurriedly flipped a f..."
entries.dialogueText: The moderator hurriedly flipped a few pages ahead in her notepad.

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""As long as this man is in office,..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as this man is in office, Bludish citizens in Sordland will never be safe."

entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""Unsubstantiated rumors have no pla..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unsubstantiated rumors have no place in this debate, Mr. Stahler."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""It's the President's job to look a..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's the President's job to look after the safety of the Sordish people, and that's exactly what he has done. Although, of course, I believe more extreme actions must be taken--"

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""It's the President's job to look a..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's the President's job to look after the safety of the Sordish people, and that's exactly what he has done. Although, of course, I believe more safety measures could have been taken--"

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""But a radical response was inevita..."
entries.dialogueText: "But a radical response was inevitable given the way the President continued the oppressive policies of his predecessors."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas' voice was syrupy-sweet."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas' voice was syrupy-sweet.

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""As long as this man remains in off..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as this man remains in office, no minority in Sordland will be safe."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Gentlemen.""
entries.dialogueText: "Gentlemen."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""Well? Nobody else is going to addr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well? Nobody else is going to address the allegations of bribery and corruption between Rayne and Ricter here?"

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Electing Sordland's first leader o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Electing Sordland's first leader of Bludish descent would help to create a bridge of lasting peace between our communities."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""What about the governor's safety?..."
entries.dialogueText: "What about the governor's safety? What about the Soll Dam employees? The Bludish scum cannot be trusted to--"

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""What about the governor's safety?..."
entries.dialogueText: "What about the governor's safety? What about the Soll Dam employees? The Bludish people must recognize that this isn't right--"

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""For someone who is against the dif..."
entries.dialogueText: "For someone who is against the different treatment of races you seem to put one race ahead of the other."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""We all know how well you two work..."
entries.dialogueText: "We all know how well you two work together."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""No. No!""
entries.dialogueText: "No. No!"

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""Look at you lovebirds, pretending..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look at you lovebirds, pretending to bicker."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""I'll spare you viewers another of..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll spare you viewers another of the NFP's racist tirades."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I sat back and said nothing."
entries.dialogueText: I sat back and said nothing.
entries.menuText: Say nothing.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His eyes focused on him."
entries.dialogueText: His eyes focused on him.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Your so-called democracy will resu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your so-called democracy will result in the Bludish people losing the rights I have won for them."
entries.menuText: "Your so-called democracy will result in the Bludish people losing the rights I have won for them."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His eyes were practically bulging."
entries.dialogueText: His eyes were practically bulging.

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""Sordland must be led by capable pe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sordland must be led by capable people who understand and can represent the majority of the population. This has been the case since our great country was founded. I find it very dangerous that merits are thrown out of the window in support of an agenda. A blinded thought."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""Sordland must be led by a maroon-b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sordland must be led by a maroon-blooded Sord, as has been the case since our great country was founded. It's exactly this kind of dangerous talk that proves why the Bludish question must be solved once and for--"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What are you talking about? I've m..."
entries.dialogueText: "What are you talking about? I've made Sordland more stable than ever."
entries.menuText: "What are you talking about? I've made Sordland more stable than ever."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""That's exactly what I mean. Such a..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's exactly what I mean. Such a rash and vindictive decision from an acting president. Is this what Sordland wants?"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""No. I disagreed with certain of th..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. I disagreed with certain of the Colonel's more brutally oppressive policies. I shall bring Soll's core values into a more enlightened, morally correct administration."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Your willingness to rebel against..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your willingness to rebel against the wishes of your own party means you cannot be trusted as a leader."

entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""This seems a good enough a time as..."
entries.dialogueText: "This seems a good enough a time as any to bring up the allegations that President Rayne has abused his power while in office."

entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""You've gone over your speaking tim..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've gone over your speaking time, Ms. Graf."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas neatly folded her arms and s..."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas neatly folded her arms and sat back in her chair.

entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""You've gone over your speaking tim..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've gone over your speaking time, Ms. Graf."

entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""I believe it's time to move on to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe it's time to move on to another subject."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She hurriedly flipped through her n..."
entries.dialogueText: She hurriedly flipped through her notes.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Nothing but a smear campaign to pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing but a smear campaign to prevent my re-election."
entries.menuText: "Nothing but a smear campaign to prevent my re-election."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Compared to the blatant corruption..."
entries.dialogueText: "Compared to the blatant corruption of my predecessors, I'd say I'm doing pretty well for myself."
entries.menuText: "Compared to the blatant corruption of my predecessors, I'd say I'm doing pretty well for myself."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The mistakes I made were those of..."
entries.dialogueText: "The mistakes I made were those of a young and inexperienced president. They will not be repeated again."
entries.menuText: "The mistakes I made were those of a young and inexperienced president. They will not be repeated again."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I refuse to comment on said allega..."
entries.dialogueText: "I refuse to comment on said allegations at this time."
entries.menuText: "I refuse to comment on said allegations at this time."

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: "My press spokesperson has already issued a statement regarding the innocent misunderstanding between Mr. Clavin and myself. I will not rehash it here."
entries.menuText: "My press spokesperson has already issued a statement regarding the innocent misunderstanding between Mr. Clavin and myself. I will not rehash it here."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will remember your lack of loyal..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will remember your lack of loyalty during my next term."
entries.menuText: "I will remember your lack of loyalty during my next term."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You liar! You practically begged m..."
entries.dialogueText: "You liar! You practically begged me for that check."
entries.menuText: "You liar! You practically begged me for that check."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""This is politics. You know the say..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is politics. You know the saying: You've got to kill the cow to make the zabla."
entries.menuText: "This is politics. You know the saying: You've got to kill the cow to make the zabla."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you, Frens.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Frens."
entries.menuText: "Thank you, Frens."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I kept my mouth shut."
entries.dialogueText: I kept my mouth shut.
entries.menuText: Say nothing.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Is this a debate or a witch hunt?..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is this a debate or a witch hunt? Can we move on?"
entries.menuText: "Is this a debate or a witch hunt? Can we move on?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The other candidates tittered."
entries.dialogueText: The other candidates tittered.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Is this a debate or a witch hunt?..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is this a debate or a witch hunt? Can we move on?"
entries.menuText: "Is this a debate or a witch hunt? Can we move on?"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I was a part of the administration..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was a part of the administration. It was every bit as bad as they say."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Shut up, all of you! I am your Pre..."
entries.dialogueText: "Shut up, all of you! I am your President!"
entries.menuText: "Shut up, all of you! I am your President!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""MODERATOR! Next question!""
entries.dialogueText: "MODERATOR! Next question!"
entries.menuText: "MODERATOR! Next question!"

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I ignored them."
entries.dialogueText: I ignored them.
entries.menuText: Say nothing.

entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""Ahem... it's time we moved on anyw..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ahem... it's time we moved on anyway."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Stop that high-and-mighty act. I k..."
entries.dialogueText: "Stop that high-and-mighty act. I know who you really are."
entries.menuText: "Stop that high-and-mighty act. I know who you really are."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""Rest assured the PFJP is committed..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rest assured the PFJP is committed to purging corruption from the Maroon Palace."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""Rest assured my party is committed..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rest assured my party is committed to purging corruption from the Maroon Palace."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""I'm sure you recall that one of hi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure you recall that one of his very first acts in office was to effectively shut the country's only Bludish party off from campaign funding..."

entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""Indeed I do.""
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed I do."

entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""The President had a perfectly good..."
entries.dialogueText: "The President had a perfectly good explanation for that."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Uh... regardless, electing Sordlan..."
entries.dialogueText: "Uh... regardless, electing Sordland's first leader of Bludish descent would help to create a bridge of lasting peace between our communities."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mansoun raised an eyebrow."
entries.dialogueText: Mansoun raised an eyebrow.

entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""Yes, I remember that well.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I remember that well."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""You've been attempting to undermin..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've been attempting to undermine my people from the moment you took office. Beginning with that bill depriving our party of election funding."

entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""The President had a perfectly good..."
entries.dialogueText: "The President had a perfectly good explanation for that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mansoun raised an eyebrow."
entries.dialogueText: Mansoun raised an eyebrow.

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Uh... regardless, as long as this..."
entries.dialogueText: "Uh... regardless, as long as this man is in the Maroon Palace, no minority in Sordland will be safe."

entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""Yes, I remember that well.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I remember that well."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""You've been attempting to undermin..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've been attempting to undermine the Bludish people from the moment you took office. Beginning with that bill depriving their party -- and mine -- of election funding."

entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""The President had a perfectly good..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Denis raised an eyebrow."
entries.dialogueText: Denis raised an eyebrow.

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""It's true that xenophobia is alive..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's true that xenophobia is alive and well in Sordland. Despite the president's best efforts."

entries.speaker: Manoly Suheil
entries.title: Manoly Suheil: ""It's true that xenophobia is alive..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's true that xenophobia is alive and well in Sordland. Despite the president's best efforts."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Gentlemen. Ms. Suheil.""
entries.dialogueText: "Gentlemen. Ms. Suheil."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Denis, calm down.""
entries.dialogueText: "Denis, calm down."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""No. The charade has gone on long e..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. The charade has gone on long enough. How can the blatant censorship of the media go unremarked upon on this stage?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Denis rose from his seat."
entries.dialogueText: Denis rose from his seat.

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""Admiration? You had me thrown in p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Admiration? You had me thrown in prison!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Denis, I have nothing but admirati..."
entries.dialogueText: "Denis, I have nothing but admiration for you and your ideology. Please do not test my goodwill."
entries.menuText: "Denis, I have nothing but admiration for you and your ideology. Please do not test my goodwill."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""Unbelievable.""
entries.dialogueText: "Unbelievable."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""They're more violent than they use..."
entries.dialogueText: "They're more violent than they used to be, I'll agree with you there. But your reaction crossed a line."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""This charade has gone on long enou..."
entries.dialogueText: "This charade has gone on long enough. Can't you others see he has the media rigged against us?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The Red Youth was out of control...."
entries.dialogueText: "The Red Youth was out of control. You should have done something."
entries.menuText: "The Red Youth was out of control. You should have done something."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't make me do it again.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't make me do it again."
entries.menuText: "Don't make me do it again."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He and Denis walked out of the stud..."
entries.dialogueText: He and Denis walked out of the studio. None of the other candidates spoke.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I didn't give that order.""
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't give that order."
entries.menuText: "I didn't give that order."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Denis loudly pushed his chair back..."
entries.dialogueText: Denis loudly pushed his chair back and stormed out of the studio. None of the other candidates spoke.

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""Not to mention the disappearance o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not to mention the disappearance of one of the most prominent opposition leaders."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""Not to mention the disappearance o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not to mention the disappearance of one of the most prominent opposition parties."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""Let's go, Mansoun.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's go, Mansoun."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""It doesn't have to be this way. Vo..."
entries.dialogueText: "It doesn't have to be this way. Vote People's Front for real change in '57."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""To say nothing of the mysterious d..."
entries.dialogueText: "To say nothing of the mysterious deaths of certain individuals in the President's orbit..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Leave this building. Now.""
entries.dialogueText: "Leave this building. Now."
entries.menuText: "Leave this building. Now."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Sorry, Denis, I can't risk it. You..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry, Denis, I can't risk it. You're on your own."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The studio went deathly silent."
entries.dialogueText: The studio went deathly silent.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mansoun got up and looked into the..."
entries.dialogueText: Mansoun got up and looked into the camera.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Mr. Stahler. If I really am as pow..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Stahler. If I really am as powerful as you claim, wouldn't it be extremely foolish of you to speak against me?"
entries.menuText: "Mr. Stahler. If I really am as powerful as you claim, wouldn't it be extremely foolish of you to speak against me?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sit back down. Now.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sit back down. Now."
entries.menuText: "Sit back down. Now."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Mr. Stahler. Leave this stage and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Stahler. Leave this stage and do not ever show your face in front of me again."
entries.menuText: "Mr. Stahler. Leave this stage and do not ever show your face in front of me again."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""I'll find my own way out.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll find my own way out."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""The hell you do.""
entries.dialogueText: "The hell you do."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I have no idea what you're talking..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have no idea what you're talking about."
entries.menuText: "I have no idea what you're talking about."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""Abdicating responsibility. A good..."
entries.dialogueText: "Abdicating responsibility. A good look for a President."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""If I was censoring the media, woul..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I was censoring the media, would I permit you to make this kind of scene?"
entries.menuText: "If I was censoring the media, would I permit you to make this kind of scene?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Whatever you think you know about..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever you think you know about me, it's a lie."
entries.menuText: "Whatever you think you know about me, it's a lie."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Denis gaped at me indignantly, then..."
entries.dialogueText: Denis gaped at me indignantly, then sat, his face red.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Guards, this man is a danger to me..."
entries.dialogueText: "Guards, this man is a danger to me. Please escort him out of the building at once."
entries.menuText: "Guards, this man is a danger to me. Please escort him out of the building at once."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Denis sat, his face red. None of th..."
entries.dialogueText: Denis sat, his face red. None of the other candidates spoke.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Denis paled slightly."
entries.dialogueText: Denis paled slightly.

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""I won't play this game a second lo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't play this game a second longer."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""Let's just get this dog and pony s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's just get this dog and pony show over with."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""Gladly.""
entries.dialogueText: "Gladly."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""I cannot fucking believe this!""
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot fucking believe this!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The moderator took a moment to rega..."
entries.dialogueText: The moderator took a moment to regain her composure.

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""Bludish citizens in Sordland shoul..."
entries.dialogueText: "Bludish citizens in Sordland should be safe."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""The great Bludish people wish to b..."
entries.dialogueText: "The great Bludish people wish to be safe."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""Since our confrontation in Narbel,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Since our confrontation in Narbel, I've known exactly what kind of man you are, President Rayne."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""When we met in Narbel, you present..."
entries.dialogueText: "When we met in Narbel, you presented yourself as a reasonable man. But it was all an act, wasn't it, President Rayne?"
